items.summary: Reject all new proposals, high-priority queue work, production changes, monetization expansion, unsupported financial claims, telemetry duplication, and duplicate retries this cycle. Preserve only existing bounded reversible work with its current owners, quality gates, rollback notes, and measurement thresholds. Amazon evidence supports only $4.92 aggregate unattributed commission for 2026-09-21; site revenue, margin, ROI, CAC, payback, forecasts, and causal lift remain unsupported. Keep SearchWoot private pending the owner's choice on an unsent permission request, no outreach, or ending the public-beta pursuit.

Continue the existing Great American Lakes measurement gate and retain the already-produced marineactivity.com and aliencouncil.com report-only baselines. Do not create new queue requests or duplicate failed work. Stop or reject any change lacking a measurable outcome, supported attribution, explicit rollback, and passed quality and smoke checks.

SearchWoot remains private. Source rights, legal, security, accuracy, privacy, attribution, and measurement gates are unresolved. No launch, outreach, credential, configuration, schedule, spending, telemetry, or production action is authorized without the owner's disposition and completed gates.

Recommendation: preserve only bounded, reversible report-only work and route three existing evidence baselines to engineer across distinct sites. Reject new production, monetization, unsupported financial claims, high-priority queue work, telemetry duplication, spending, credential changes, and launch activity. Amazon commission remains $4.92 aggregate and unattributed; site revenue, margin, ROI, CAC, payback, forecasts, and causal lift are unsupported. SearchWoot remains private pending owner direction and unresolved rights, legal, security, accuracy, privacy, attribution, and measurement gates.

Owner decision required: choose one SearchWoot disposition—authorize preparation of an unsent provider-permission request, keep private with no outreach, or end the public-beta pursuit. No outreach, launch, production, credential, configuration, telemetry, spending, or schedule changes are authorized.
